meta.title: Extend a live RFQ by 15 Minutes
gaps: Verify the updated end time in the events list.
Verify that the vendor portal shows the same updated end time.
Verify that vendors can still bid until the extended end time.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify the updated end time in the events list.; Verify that the vendor portal shows the same updated end time.; Verify that vendors can still bid until the extended end time.

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary as required for an existing event.
Choose Custom, enter 15 Minutes, submit the extension, and verify the new end is exactly the prior end plus 15 minutes.
Verify the expected success message after the extension is saved.
